records.title: Binance hack: chain-by-chain on-chain investigation
records.note: Bitquery independently traces five Binance-attributed XRPL accounts sending about 233.5M XRP to a newly created receiver. It reports the receiver still held 233.5M XRP and had never sent a transaction at 03:54 UTC on Oct 30. It identifies the public receiver as rK21t6nGLy4MNDqhvy3pGwcLFy25qgfzMx. Bitquery says the XRPL and Solana drains share no address with the other incident chains; linkage is based on timing, unusual transaction construction and Binance's own total. Its public report covers nine chains, versus TRM's ten-chain scope. Same underlying public ledger, independent analytics provider; not an independent primary source.

records.title: Binance says deposits normal, withdrawals paused for security revamp
records.note: A Binance News post marked as the verified official account says deposits are operating normally, withdrawals remain paused during a security overhaul, and Binance expects withdrawals to resume within 48 hours. It says the full attack path is still under investigation and a comprehensive report will follow. This is a later status update than the initial statement that both deposits and withdrawals were temporarily suspended.

records.title: Reuters: Binance freezes assets after $6.3 billion heist
records.note: Reuters reports Binance's $6.3B impact estimate, about $3B frozen, deposits unaffected and withdrawals expected to resume within 48 hours; it reports BTC/ETH and crypto-equity market reaction, Coinbase's statement that it was unaffected, and TRM/Chainalysis attribution claims. Reuters is independent journalism but its threat-actor attribution is sourced to the analytics firms, not an independently reproduced XRPL trace.

records.title: CoinDesk: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets
records.note: CoinDesk's review says the Ethereum hot wallet Binance 14 appears in Binance's Oct 1 proof-of-reserves set; its reported pre-event ETH reserve ratio was 100%, and the stolen ~204,500 ETH could imply ~94% coverage until replenished. It also reports 108.26% pre-event USDC coverage. This does not calculate an XRP reserve ratio and does not establish the five XRPL wallet balances or current customer liabilities.

records.title: Alpha Finance XRP ETF dashboard through Oct 29
records.note: Dashboard reports +$8.4M XRP ETF net flow for Oct 29 across five funds, +$98.9M over 30 sessions and $1.73B cumulative net inflow. The fund table includes XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP and TOXR; XRPR is not in this displayed five-fund universe. This is a provider-derived flow series, not issuer-level reconciliation.

records.title: CryptoETF.today XRP ETF flow tracker, partial Oct 29
records.note: Reports +$7.1M for Oct 29 but explicitly says only two of five funds had reported. The figure is partial and must not be compared as a completed daily total with Alpha Finance's five-fund +$8.4M.

records.title: XRP Insights issuer-holdings and ETF-flow dataset
records.note: Dataset reports holdings through Oct 28 of 1,190,251,285 XRP across six spot funds plus BITW; Oct 28 flow +174,140 XRP and Oct 26-28 combined flow -2,958,545 XRP. GXRP is excluded from flow totals while its holdings remain in total holdings; Oct 29 is provisional. Its universe and methodology differ from Alpha Finance and CryptoETF.today.
